name: imessage-mcp
description: Read, search and send iMessage on macOS without Full Disk Access. Requires the iMessage MCP app.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search and send iMessage without Full Disk Access
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the iMessage MCP macOS app: a sandboxed app with a read-only grant to your Messages folder. Every connection and every send needs your approval in the app. Install the app first, then switch the bridge on in its window.
defaultPrompt: Use iMessage MCP to list my recent conversations.
Use iMessage MCP to search my messages for a keyword.
